metaTitle: Satis Score: verified ratings from real customers
metaDescription: Before you try a café, restaurant or clinic, check its Satis Score. Every rating comes from a customer who really visited or bought.

directory.title:
Before you try it,

ask the people who did.
directory.body: Every rating here comes from a customer who really visited or bought, invited by Satis after paying.
directory.searchPlaceholder: Search for a café, store, clinic…
directory.stats: {ratings} verified ratings from customers in {cities} cities
directory.emptyBody: Try a shorter name or another category.
directory.emptyAllTitle: The first brands are on their way
directory.emptyAllBody: Brands that open their page on Satis Score appear here.
directory.featuredBody: {count} verified ratings in the last 12 months.

seal.title: If you see the yellow seal,
seal.body: It shows on brands' websites and next to the buy button. Tap it to land on the brand's page here and read the ratings yourself.

invite.title: Invited after a real visit
invite.body: The invitation arrives after paying, by WhatsApp or the code on the receipt. There's no “write a review” button for anyone.

consent.title: Published with the customer's consent
consent.body: Only the first name shows. Stars always count; the comment is published if its writer agrees.

reply.title: Brands reply, they don't delete
reply.body: A brand can answer any rating in public, but can't hide or edit it.

cta.title: Let your customers' satisfaction sell for you.
cta.body: Collect verified ratings from WhatsApp, the till and your website, answer them in one place, and show the Satis seal next to the buy button.

profile.fallbackAbout: Every rating here comes from a customer who visited {name} and was invited by Satis after paying.
profile.scoreSummary: {name}'s Satis Score: {score} out of 5, from {count} verified ratings in the last 12 months.
profile.collectingBody: The number appears after {min} verified ratings. {count} so far.
profile.yearSummary: Average of each of the last 12 months.
profile.noYear: The line appears after the first month with ratings.

how.title: How we verify ratings
how.invite: The invitation arrives after a real visit or purchase.
how.consent: Comments are published with the customer's consent, first name only.
how.reply: The brand replies or reports, but never deletes.

rate.title: Want to rate {name}?
rate.body: The invitation reaches you after you pay at any branch, by WhatsApp or the receipt code. No account needed.

owner.title: Own {name}?
owner.body: Answer your customers and put the Satis seal on your website.

profile.noReviewsBody: Stars count from every rating. Comments appear here once their writers agree to publish them.

page.enabledHint: Your brand appears in Satis Score search and on Google.
page.reviewsHint: After the survey, customers are asked whether to publish their comment. It shows with their first name only, and only if they agree.
page.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes, like ward-cafe.
page.aboutHint: Shows under your brand name. Up to 280 characters.

badge.title: Your website badge
badge.body: Paste this code into your website. The badge shows your score and opens your page when tapped.
badge.off: Turn on your public page first for the badge to show.
